title: Customer Service
summary: Canonical vendor-neutral Customer Service and Digital Assist business Journey covering customer contact, identification and context, agent interaction, enquiry and assisted servicing, full request/case lifecycle, independent domain-Journey handoff, entitlement, consent, escalation, resolution, communication and controlled Engagement boundaries.

payload.text: Customer Service connects customer intent with authorized information, servicing, independent domain Journeys and controlled operational work. Digital Assist is the business capability through which service staff establish context, guide customers, initiate permitted actions, manage requests or cases, and retain traceable ownership through resolution.

payload.title: Authorization boundary
payload.text: Customer Service access never implies access to another banking Journey, product context or Engagement content. Every cross-domain read and handoff must be independently authorized before protected data is retrieved or exposed.

Establish a traceable interaction, identify the customer, apply the required authentication checkpoint and retrieve only the customer, product, service, consent and preference context authorized for the service purpose.

payload.title: Customer Service / Digital Assist End-to-End Business Process
payload.description: High-level responsibility flow for customer contact, identity and authentication checkpoints, enquiry resolution, authorized servicing, independent domain-Journey handoff, case processing, communication, service recovery and closure.
payload.scope: Vendor-neutral Customer Service and Digital Assist. Engagement is represented only as authorized context or handoff; target domain Journeys retain their own authorization, rules, validations, states and BPMN.

businessRules.title: Customer identification
businessRules.description: A service interaction must be associated with the correct customer or explicitly handled as an unidentified enquiry.

businessRules.title: Authentication applicability
businessRules.description: Authentication strength must match the requested information or action under applicable bank policy.

businessRules.title: Customer context visibility
businessRules.description: Only context authorized for the customer, agent, purpose and current interaction may be displayed.

businessRules.title: Agent entitlement
businessRules.description: Every agent action must be allowed by current role, team, assignment and action entitlement.

businessRules.title: Service eligibility
businessRules.description: The customer, product and request must be eligible before an action is initiated or submitted.

businessRules.title: View permission
businessRules.description: View access does not imply permission to change or submit customer information.

businessRules.title: Guided service
businessRules.description: Guidance must not be represented as execution of the customer action.

businessRules.title: Assisted initiation
businessRules.description: Assisted initiation requires an authorized target Journey and sufficient customer context.

businessRules.title: Servicing action
businessRules.description: A servicing action requires explicit action eligibility and any required authentication or consent.

businessRules.title: Submission
businessRules.description: Submission must preserve the initiating agent, customer context, request data and outcome reference.

businessRules.title: Approval authority
businessRules.description: Approval or decision authority must remain separate from initiation where segregation of duties applies.

businessRules.title: Customer consent
businessRules.description: Consent or acknowledgement must be captured where required for the action and data-use purpose.

businessRules.title: Request completeness
businessRules.description: Required information must be complete before routing or submission.

businessRules.title: Case ownership
businessRules.description: Every open case must have an accountable owner or governed queue.

businessRules.title: Assignment
businessRules.description: Assignment must follow configured skill, team, product, language, channel and workload criteria where applicable.

businessRules.title: Routing
businessRules.description: Routing decisions and overrides must be traceable.

businessRules.title: Escalation
businessRules.description: Escalation follows applicable policy based on risk, complaint, service level, authority or unresolved outcome.

businessRules.title: Reopen
businessRules.description: A resolved or closed case may reopen only for a valid related reason under applicable policy.

businessRules.title: Resolution
businessRules.description: Resolution must record the decision, action, evidence, owner and customer-facing outcome.

businessRules.title: Closure
businessRules.description: Closure requires completion of mandatory actions, communications and audit evidence.

businessRules.title: Cross-Journey access
businessRules.description: Customer Service may access only target Journeys and context independently authorized for the user and purpose.

businessRules.title: Handoff
businessRules.description: A handoff must preserve a correlation reference without copying the target Journey state model or rules.

businessRules.title: Communication preference
businessRules.description: Permitted channel and preference context must be evaluated before non-mandatory communication.

businessRules.title: Service communication
businessRules.description: Mandatory service communication follows applicable policy even where marketing consent is absent.

businessRules.title: Engagement context
businessRules.description: Notification or engagement context is visible only when independently authorized and relevant to service.

businessRules.title: Duplicate prevention
businessRules.description: Potential duplicate requests and cases must be detected before a new record is confirmed.

businessRules.title: Sensitive data
businessRules.description: Sensitive data must be minimized and masked according to purpose, role and policy.

businessRules.title: Auditability
businessRules.description: Material views, decisions, changes, submissions, handoffs and overrides must leave traceable evidence.

Authentication strength must match the requested information or action under applicable bank policy.

Every agent action must be allowed by current role, team, assignment and action entitlement.
The customer, product and request must be eligible before an action is initiated or submitted.
View access does not imply permission to change or submit customer information.
Guidance must not be represented as execution of the customer action.
Assisted initiation requires an authorized target Journey and sufficient customer context.
A servicing action requires explicit action eligibility and any required authentication or consent.
Submission must preserve the initiating agent, customer context, request data and outcome reference.

Consent or acknowledgement must be captured where required for the action and data-use purpose.
Required information must be complete before routing or submission.
Every open case must have an accountable owner or governed queue.
Assignment must follow configured skill, team, product, language, channel and workload criteria where applicable.
Routing decisions and overrides must be traceable.
Escalation follows applicable policy based on risk, complaint, service level, authority or unresolved outcome.
A resolved or closed case may reopen only for a valid related reason under applicable policy.
Resolution must record the decision, action, evidence, owner and customer-facing outcome.
Closure requires completion of mandatory actions, communications and audit evidence.
Customer Service may access only target Journeys and context independently authorized for the user and purpose.
A handoff must preserve a correlation reference without copying the target Journey state model or rules.
Permitted channel and preference context must be evaluated before non-mandatory communication.
Mandatory service communication follows applicable policy even where marketing consent is absent.
Notification or engagement context is visible only when independently authorized and relevant to service.
Potential duplicate requests and cases must be detected before a new record is confirmed.
Sensitive data must be minimized and masked according to purpose, role and policy.
Material views, decisions, changes, submissions, handoffs and overrides must leave traceable evidence.
